# camundacluster_client_group_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a client (an OAuth/OIDC client provisioned externally via the identity provider) to a Camunda cluster group. Members of the group inherit the group's authorizations, roles, and tenant assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Assign an OIDC client, provisioned externally through the identity provider,
# to a Camunda cluster group. Members of the group inherit the group's
# authorizations, roles, and tenant assignments.
resource "camundacluster_client_group_assignment" "example" {
  group_id  = "my-group"
  client_id = "my-oidc-client-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The ID of the client (as issued by the identity provider) to assign to the group.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group the client is assigned to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this assignment, composed of `group_id` and `client_id`.
